questions.question: Big family, two brothers. Elder brother marries, very big wedding, very many songs. Younger brother and bhabhi's sister are doing teasing, stealing shoes, taking money, more songs. Then bhabhi falls from stairs and goes to God. Now whole family wants sister marries elder brother, and sister says okay because family, but she loves the younger one. Nobody is asking her. Only the dog is understanding. Dog carries the letter and solves full film. Dog is real hero.

questions.question: Time pass boy has a perfect older brother. Time pass boy likes rich girl, boy likes and says he is also rich, girl who fixes his car loves time pass boy, but boy does not notice because she fixes car. Then rich school boys are mean and rich school boy pushes perfect brother down the hill. Now boy has to stop doing time pass, boy does what perfect older brother does and enter cycling competition very hard and win. Time pass boy finally notice girl who fixes car and the feeling he feels is first drunk, first love, new love, new waiting...
questions.bonus: Sing a line of "Pehla Nasha" while spinning in slow motion

questions.question: Mumbai tiffin men are never making mistake, very famous, foreign university is studying them. But one day they make mistake. Wife is cooking very nice food so husband loves her again, but food goes to old uncle who is retiring from office. Uncle eats everything and sends back empty box. Wife is happy, then confused. Now they are writing letters inside tiffin, every day. Then they decide to meet in café. Uncle comes, sees she is young, feels he is old, and does not go. Film ends. Nobody tells us anything. Very rude.

questions.question: Old Bengali father has only one subject: his stomach. Morning, evening, dinner table, in front of guests: stomach. Daughter is angry all the time but she loves him. Father wants to go Kolkata but will not sit in aeroplane, so they go by car, and taxi company owner has to drive himself because no driver will go with this family. Full road trip is about potty. Taxi owner is suffering. In end, father finally has one very successful morning, and he is so happy he dies. Happy ending.

questions.question: Village where rain is never stopping. Old big house, and below house, in a hole, is a hungry god whom nobody is allowed to worship. He has gold coins in his underwear. Man goes down with atta dolls, tricks him, takes coins, again and again, becomes rich. Man is very greedy and he teaches his son also to be greedy. Son goes down for more coins and makes very big mistake. Also great-grandmother upstairs is slowly becoming a tree. Do not ask.
questions.bonus: Whisper "Hastar" in your spookiest voice
